accuracy.question: How accurate are these calculations?
accuracy.answer: Our calculators use the latest published pricing from each provider. However, actual costs may vary based on usage patterns, caching, and provider-specific billing rules.

update.question: How often is pricing data updated?
update.answer: We update pricing data whenever providers announce changes. Always verify with official provider documentation for the most current rates.

free.question: Are these calculators free to use?
free.answer: Yes, all calculators are completely free to use with no registration required.

providers.question: Which AI providers are supported?
providers.answer: We currently support Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), and DeepSeek. We plan to add more providers in the future.

footer.disclaimer: Disclaimer: Calculations are estimates based on published pricing. Actual costs may vary. Always refer to official provider documentation for authoritative pricing.
